DURAN TREBLE TARGET

0
By CQN Magazine on 17th November 2026 Latest News
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:32
Instaread

CAMILO DURAN is a man on a mission as Colombia prepare for the return leg of the international friendly double-header against Chile in Santiago this evening.

Powered By
10
Share
Next
Stay

Celtic’s 13-goal top marksman hopes to get the nod to make his fourth international appearance following his debut against Paraguay last month.

Duran played in the 2-0 victory over Peru in Miami in the next match, but limped off on the hour mark of the 1-0 win over Chile where he was instrumental in the build-up to the game’s only goal which was deflected into his own net by defender Guillermo Maripan in the 35th minute.

HANDS UP IF YOU’RE HAPPY…Camilo Duran celebrates his second strike in Celtic’s 3-2 Europa League win over Besiktas as the Colombian pushes his goal tally to 13 in his debut campaign.

ADVERTISEMENT

Fears over in-form Duran were quickly eased when boss Nestor Lorenzo revealed his legs had cramped and that’s why he was replaced.

Now the 24-year-old frontman is eager to prove his fitness and continue his fine goalscoring form at Celtic since his £9million arrival from Qarabag AND claim his first strike for his country.

Duran is scheduled to return to Parkhead later in the week as Martin O’Neill prepares for Saturday’s 3pm visit of St Mirren when the Premiership resumes.

The champions are four points ahead at the top of the league and can extend that to seven for a few hours at least with their closest challengers from Ibrox scheduled to play Motherwell at Fir Park with an 8pm kick-off.
